name: TRACK 01 — Railway Nightclub
artDirection: Feature-complete premium faded dark-red retired railway nightclub with lobby-first arrival, forward Night Ticket flow, and a restrained Platform 01 to Car 01 boarding sequence using one blinking amber arrow plus a functional aged-steel threshold bridge. Audio remains v4.2.2 stable: 62 permissioned tracks, equal-power 7-second automix, Car 01-04 only, one centered phase-safe emitter per car, stronger default level, follower recovery, and Skatepark hard-excluded.
